beats.text: PLACEHOLDER PROSE. Betty has the count. She has had it since the beach, she has kept it in her head rather than on paper, and she says it out loud once.
PLACEHOLDER PROSE. They dig. Michael does not delegate it, does not make a ceremony of it, and does not stop when it stops being useful to be seen doing it.
PLACEHOLDER PROSE. Afterward she tells him what she will do for him and what she will not, in that order, and means both. This is the first thing she has promised anyone since the ship went down.
